notes: Stories defined for tool routing, validation, and orchestration based on existing tool_router implementation.

change_log.value: Added schema and contract story for tool routing inputs/outputs
Added core logic story for allowlist routing and dispatch
Added chat history injection and tool-use handling story
Added API integration story with FastAPI main loop

SHARED-B-M1-S1.title: Define Tool Routing Schema and Validation Contract
SHARED-B-M1-S1.description: Define Pydantic models for tool inputs, outputs, and validation errors. Establish strict schema enforcement for all allowlisted tools to ensure safe execution.

SHARED-B-M1-S2.title: Implement Allowlist-Based Tool Routing Logic
SHARED-B-M1-S2.description: Build core routing engine that dispatches tool calls based on a strict allowlist. Reject unknown tools and enforce governance constraints (GOV-004).

SHARED-B-M1-S3.title: Implement Chat History Injection and Tool Use Handling
SHARED-B-M1-S3.description: Integrate chat history into tool execution context and support Anthropic tool_use blocks for multi-step agent workflows.

SHARED-B-M1-S4.title: Integrate Tool Router with FastAPI Application Loop
SHARED-B-M1-S4.description: Connect tool routing system to main FastAPI entrypoint, ensuring tool calls are executed within the request lifecycle and responses are returned to the chat client.

SHARED-B-M1-S5.title: Develop Unit and Integration Tests for Tool Routing
SHARED-B-M1-S5.description: Create comprehensive tests covering allowlist enforcement, schema validation failures, tool execution success paths, and chat history handling.

SHARED-B-M1.mitigation: Strict allowlist enforcement and schema validation already defined in tool_router
